Commissioned by the human 2026-08-05/06 from the lane-quality assessment. ADR-0061 decision 3 made review eligible for foreign lanes and named provider diversity as the point — one pass with two lenses, not two passes. The seat exists on paper and has never been dispatched; meanwhile architecture, design and code quality are measured by nothing per-issue.

Scope: stand up the cross-provider review seat as a standing second lens. (1) Define the review dispatch: input is a landed SHA plus its issue and close audit; output is claims, each citing the code it checks — a review lands nothing (that is its gate, per the #228 ruling). (2) Its report follows the paste discipline and the telegraphic norm; claims route as issues (defects) or comments (observations), filed by the orchestrator or by the reviewer if permissions allow. (3) First exercises: one z.ai review of a Claude-landed issue and one Claude review of the z.ai-landed #92 (ff7e3a3) — both lenses demonstrated, cost quoted in the appropriate currency per lane. (4) State how review findings feed the admission bar's Part B (a confirmed review finding within the window is an unclean mark — align with tools/admission.py's reasons or say why not). (5) Design/architecture depth stays proportionate: the review checks grain and structure against CLAUDE.md's conventions and the ADRs the diff touches, not taste — the periodic deep passes (#139) remain separate.
